document.abstract: High-speed photographic methods used with commercially available moving film cameras are reviewed in this paper. Careful planning in regard to field size, reference lines, background and timing as well as other factors can contribute a great deal toward producing films which furnish a maximum of useful information. Special techniques employed in analysis can likewise simplify the task of data reduction. Some of these methods are illustrated.
